scope: HITL-002 candidate-bound safe Approval projection and durable public-process linkage on disposable PostgreSQL/MinIO.

observations.safe_projection: The public approval lifecycle preserves its caller-safe bounded linkage and state across restart without exposing private tool descriptors or capability values.
observations.limitations: This does not prove a browser, Stack, Workspace service, protected sandbox, Firecracker, or Linux/KVM path.

redaction: No IDs, tokens, descriptors, capability values, credentials, DSNs, or endpoints are retained.
